message.content:
Based on the provided image, here is an exhaustive, pixel-perfect description of the **ELD Trip Planner** UI, specifically the **HOS Logs (Driver's Daily Log)** screen.

### 1. Overall Layout & Screen Type
*   **Screen Type:** This is a **Log Sheet / Compliance Dashboard**. It displays a formal "Driver's Daily Log" (Form MCS-59) used for FMCSA compliance.
*   **Layout Structure:** A standard web application layout with a fixed top navigation bar, a sub-header for date navigation and actions, and a main content area containing a large, centered white card that holds the actual log form.
*   **Background:** The page background is a very light gray (`#F3F4F6`), making the white content card pop.

### 2. Top App Bar (Navigation Header)
*   **Background:** White with a subtle bottom border.
*   **Left Side:**
    *   **Logo/Brand:** A small icon resembling a truck or document followed by the text **"ELD Trip Planner"** in bold, black sans-serif font.
    *   **Navigation Tabs:**
        *   "Route Planner" (Inactive, gray text)
        *   **"HOS Logs"** (Active, bold black text, likely with an underline or distinct background pill shape—appears as a light blue/gray rounded rectangle in this design).
        *   "FMCSA Compliance" (Inactive)
        *   "Manifest" (Inactive)
*   **Right Side:**
    *   **Compliance Badge:** A rounded pill shape. Inside is a yellow/orange dot, followed by text **"70hr / 8-day cycle"**.
    *   **Help Link:** An info icon (circle with 'i') followed by **"How it works"**.
    *   **User Profile:** A dark circular avatar with a user silhouette. To its left, text reads **"James Carter"** (bold) on top and **"IL-TRK-4471"** (smaller, gray) below.

### 3. Sub-Header (Date & Action Bar)
Located directly below the main nav, above the white log card.
*   **Left - Date Navigator:**
    *   Left Arrow Icon `<`
    *   **Active Date Pill:** **"Day 1 · Oct 4, 2026"** (White background, shadow, bold text).
    *   **Inactive Date:** **"Day 2 · Oct 5, 2026"** (Gray text).
    *   Right Arrow Icon `>`
*   **Right - Actions:**
    *   **Status Badge:** Light blue background. Contains a checkmark icon and text **"49 CFR §395.8 COMPLIANT"**.
    *   **Primary CTA Button:** Orange/Yellow gradient or solid color. Contains a download icon and text **"Download All Logs (PDF)"**.

### 4. Main Content Card: Driver's Daily Log
This is the central element, a large white card with rounded corners and a subtle drop shadow.

#### A. Card Header
*   **Icon & Title:** A document icon followed by **"DRIVER'S DAILY LOG"** in large, bold, uppercase letters.
*   **Form Number:** Small text to the right of title: **"FORM MCS-59"**.
*   **Period Info (Top Right):** Text **"24-Hour Period (Midnight to Midnight)"** aligned right.

#### B. Info Grid (The "Header" fields)
A structured grid of labels and values, roughly 2 columns wide.
*   **Row 1:**
    *   **Date:** Label "DATE:" (small caps) -> Value **"10 / 04 / 2026"** (bold). Followed by "From: 00:00 To: 24:00".
    *   **Cycle/Status (Right):** Label "CYCLE:" -> Value **"70hr / 8-Day"**. Label "STATUS:" -> Value **"BALANCED"** (with a yellow dot).
*   **Row 2:**
    *   **Driver Name:** Label -> Value **"James Carter"**.
    *   **Carrier Name:** Label -> Value **"Midwest Logistics LLC"**.
*   **Row 3:**
    *   **Main Office Address:** Label -> Value **"100 Fleet St, Chicago, IL 60607"**.
    *   **Home Terminal Address:** Label -> Value **"Terminal 4, 200 Dock Rd, Joliet, IL 60436"**.
*   **Row 4:**
    *   **Truck/Tractor #:** Label -> Value **"IL-TRK-4471"** (bold) + small gray text "[VIN: 1FTFW1E84PKD72]".
    *   **Trailer #(s):** Label -> Value **"IL-TLR-2280"** + small gray text "(53ft Dry Van)".
*   **Row 5:**
    *   **Total Miles Today:** Label -> Value **"282"** (Large Bold) + **"MILES"** (small label).
    *   **Co-Driver Name:** Label -> Value *"None / Solo Driver"* (Italicized).

#### C. The Graph Grid (The Core Visual)
This is the most complex part—a graphical representation of the duty status over 24 hours.
*   **Background:** Dark navy blue/black rectangle (`#0F172A` approx).
*   **Time Axis (Y-Axis inside graph):**
    *   Vertical numbers 1 through 12 (top to bottom) representing hours.
    *   Labels **"MID"** at the top and **"NOON"** in the middle.
    *   The numbers are white, right-aligned against the left edge of the grid area.
*   **Graph Area:**
    *   The main dark area represents the time grid.
    *   There is a horizontal line graph drawn in **white** or light gray showing the duty status changes.
    *   **Visual Data:** The line starts low (Off Duty), steps up (Driving/Sleeper), has various plateaus and drops, indicating activity throughout the day.
*   **Side Headers (Right of Graph):**
    *   Dark vertical bars with white text: **"MILES"** and **"HOURS"**.
*   **Legend Rows (Below Graph):**
    *   Four rows corresponding to the Y-axis lines extending down from the graph.
    *   **1. OFF DUTY:** Line extends from graph. Value: "-" | **"8.0"**
    *   **2. SLEEPER BERTH:** Line extends. Value: "-" | **"7.9"**
    *   **3. DRIVING:** Line extends. Value: **"282"** | **"5.3"**
    *   **4. ON DUTY (not drv):** Line extends. Value: "-" | **"2.8"**
*   **Graph Footer:**
    *   Left: Asterisk note "* 15-Minute Grid Subdivisions".
    *   Center-Left: Radio/Dot icon + **"ELD Telematics Synced"**.
    *   Right: **"TOTAL 24 HR RECAP:"** (Label) | **"24.0 HOURS"** (Bold Value) | Checkmark icon in circle.

#### D. Bottom Section (Two Columns)

**Left Column: Remarks & Duty Event Audit Log**
*   **Header:** **"REMARKS & DUTY EVENT AUDIT LOG"** | Badge: **"6 Events Recorded"**.
*   **Table/List:**
    *   Time stamps in bold (e.g., **07:30**, **08:45**) on the left.
    *   Descriptive text on the right (e.g., "Pre-trip CMV & air-brake inspection...", "Load pickup completed...").
    *   Background alternates or is zebra-striped (very subtle).
*   **Shipping Documents Section:**
    *   Label **"SHIPPING DOCUMENTS"**: Value **"BOL-77451 · MIF-9902"**.
    *   Label **"SHIPPER & COMMODITY"**: Value **"ACME Freight Corp · Auto Parts (42,0..."**.

**Right Column: 70-HR / 8-Day Cycle Recap**
*   **Header:** **"70-HR / 8-DAY CYCLE RECAP"** | Badge: **"US 60/70 RULE"**.
*   **Table:**
    *   Columns: **DAY**, **DUTY (A)**, **AVAIL (B)**, **8-DAY (C)**.
    *   Rows for Day -3, Day -2, Day -1, Day 1 (Today) with specific hour values (e.g., 8.2 hr, 44.8 hr).
*   **Alert Box:**
    *   Light orange/peach background.
    *   Text: **"HOURS AVAILABLE TOMORROW"** (Small) | **"26.9 hrs"** (Large, Bold, Brown/Orange).
    *   Subtext: "Under 70hr / 8-day rolling window".
*   **Signature Section:**
    *   Header: **"DRIVER CERTIFICATION & SIGNATURE"**.
    *   Signature Image: Script font **"James Carter"**.
    *   Stamp text: **"CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY SIGNED"**.
    *   Date/Time: "Oct 04, 2026 · 16:15:22 EST".
    *   Certification text below: "I certify these entries are true and correct per FMCSA § 395.8".

### 5. Footer (Page Level)
*   **Left:** Blue dot + **"Telematics Engine v4.19 · US FMCSA 49 CFR Part 395 Verified"**.
*   **Right:** Copyright **"© 2024 ELD Trip Planner SaaS. All operational telematics rights reserved."**

### 6. Color Palette Summary
*   **Primary Action:** Amber/Orange (`#F59E0B` range) - Used for Download button and Hours Available alert.
*   **Success/Info:** Light Blue (`#DBEAFE` bg, `#1E40AF` text) - Used for Compliant badges.
*   **Graph Background:** Deep Slate/Navy (`#0F172A`).
*   **Text:** Dark Gray/Black (`#111827`) for primary, lighter Gray (`#6B7280`) for secondary labels.
*   **Background:** Very light Gray (`#F9FAFB`).

### 7. Typography Hierarchy
*   **Headings:** Bold, Uppercase or Title Case, Sans-Serif (likely Inter or Roboto).
*   **Data Values:** Bold, larger font size than labels (e.g., "282 MILES", "24.0 HOURS").
*   **Labels:** Small, Uppercase, widely tracked (letter-spaced), gray color.
*   **Log Entries:** Monospaced or tabular numbers for time columns (07:30).

### 8. Spacing & Density
*   **High Density:** The log grid and audit log pack a lot of information into a compact space.
*   **Generous Padding:** The main white card has significant padding (approx 24px-32px) to breathe.
*   **Grid Alignment:** Strict alignment in the header info section (labels left, values right within cells).

### 9. Sample Data Recap
*   **Driver:** James Carter (IL-TRK-4471).
*   **Date:** Oct 4, 2026.
*   **Miles:** 282.
*   **Total Hours:** 24.0.
*   **Cycle Status:** Balanced (26.9 hrs available tomorrow).
*   **Events:** 6 events (Pre-trip at 07:30, Load at 08:45, Break at 12:00, Fuel at 13:30, Delivery at 15:05, Post-trip at 16:05).
